stem:
Komal studies the diagonals of a rhombus.

Which two claims are correct?

options.text: The diagonals of a rhombus meet at $90^{\circ}$.
The diagonals of a rhombus are always equal in length.
The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other.
Each diagonal of a rhombus equals a side of the rhombus.

teacher.key_rationale: Rhombus diagonals are perpendicular and bisect each other. Equal diagonals need the extra square condition. Equating a diagonal to a side swaps diagonal for side length.
